ns2:course.label: Intermediate Turkish I
ns2:course.description: Continuation of TURK 202; emphasis on the development of appropriate reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension skills in Standard and Colloquial Turkish, with increased attention to ordinary written texts. Participation in a language laboratory may be required. Summer 2008: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Fall 2008: 4 hours only. Prerequisite: TURK 202 or equivalent.
